en.metaDescription: Aolong Sun is a Statistics PhD student working across statistical modeling, data-intensive research, and machine learning.
en.name: Aolong Sun
en.headline: Turning complex data into rigorous models, interpretable evidence, and reproducible decisions.
en.shortBio: I am a Statistics PhD student at Virginia Tech, with B.S. and M.S. training in statistics from Beijing Normal University. My work spans statistical inference, experimental design, multi-source data, and applied modeling. I am building toward reliable machine-learning systems by combining scientific evaluation with hands-on implementation.

details: Statistical inference, linear models, regression, and ANOVA
Experimental design, categorical data, probability, and distribution theory
Building-climate simulation, predictive modeling, and sensitivity analysis
Scientific evaluation of AI and machine-learning models

education.degree: B.S. in Statistics · M.S. in Economic Statistics
details: Economic statistics, econometrics, and multivariate analysis
Input-output accounting, digital trade, and consumer carbon footprints
Discrete-choice modeling and applied research design

experience.role: Current Research Training · Building, Climate & Predictive Modeling
experience.summary: Connecting building-climate simulation with predictive modeling, sensitivity analysis, and the scientific evaluation of AI models.
experience.problem: Understand how building and climate inputs shape simulation and predictive-model behavior without overstating results from an ongoing research process.
experience.data: Building-climate simulation outputs, model inputs, and evaluation results produced within current research training.
experience.method: Simulation-based analysis, predictive modeling, sensitivity analysis, and structured model evaluation.
experience.outcome: An evolving research workflow focused on reproducible comparisons, uncertainty, and transparent evaluation rather than a claimed finished system.

experience.role: Project Member · Digital Trade, Input-Output & Data Governance
experience.summary: Integrated multi-regional input-output tables, customs, balance-of-payments, and international services datasets before connecting the results to Leontief analysis.
experience.problem: Digital-trade measurement depends on sources whose definitions, time coverage, and sector mappings do not naturally agree.
experience.data: Chinese multi-regional input-output tables, customs data, balance-of-payments data, and twelve service-trade categories.
experience.method: Definition reconciliation, anomaly review, machine-learning-assisted correction and imputation, followed by Leontief input-output analysis.
experience.outcome: Produced model-ready inputs for sector-linkage analysis while keeping provenance, assumptions, and data limitations visible.

experience.organization: National Bureau of Statistics of China
experience.summary: Built a structured monitoring workflow across World Bank, IMF, and OECD indicators, emphasizing verification and consistent definitions.
experience.problem: International indicators require consistent definitions and traceable sources before they can support concise economic monitoring.
experience.data: Selected economic indicators and supporting documentation from the World Bank, IMF, and OECD.
experience.method: Source verification, definition reconciliation, structured monitoring, and concise evidence-based reporting.
experience.outcome: Created a more consistent workflow for monitoring and communicating international statistical indicators.

experience.summary: Designed a tourism-intention survey and used R to study social interaction, reference groups, and market segmentation.
experience.problem: Travel preferences are not isolated decisions; social reference groups may change how market segments form.
experience.data: More than 1,300 survey responses plus economic and tourism indicators across eleven Greater Bay Area cities.
experience.method: Questionnaire and experimental design, R-based multinomial logit and discrete-choice modeling, stationarity checks, parameter comparison, and scenario diagnosis.
experience.outcome: Compared model behavior across scenarios and translated quantitative results into interpretable market-segmentation evidence.

experience.summary: Used SQL and Python to prepare operational lead data, model driver vehicle-choice intention, and connect analysis with feedback workflows.
experience.problem: Driver-acquisition workflows needed consistent lead data and a clearer view of vehicle purchase, rental, fuel, and electric preferences.
experience.data: Daily lead flows and more than 30,000 valid operational records prepared through SQL-based extraction, cleaning, and filtering.
experience.method: SQL data workflows, Python feature preparation, and a linear discriminant model for driver choice intention.
experience.outcome: Supported lead operations while developing practical awareness of model failure, sample bias, user outreach, and feedback loops.

papers.title: Structural Characteristics of the Household Carbon Footprint in an Aging Society
papers.authors: Ying Long · Jiahao Feng · Aolong Sun · Rui Wang · Yafei Wang
papers.focus: Examines household carbon footprints in an aging society by connecting age-specific consumption patterns with environmentally extended input-output life-cycle assessment and structural path analysis.

papers.title: A Novel Integrated Approach for Spatial Analysis of the Coupling Relationship and Its Driving Mechanisms of the Water–Energy–Food–Ecology–Land Nexus in the Yellow River Basin of China
papers.authors: Xianzhi Liu · Ruining Yang · Xinyue Zhang · Aolong Sun · Fei Zhang · Chunyan Li · Junming Li
papers.focus: Studies the spatial and temporal coordination, constraints, and driving mechanisms of the water–energy–food–ecology–land nexus in China’s Yellow River Basin.

papers.title: Tourism Market Segment Formation through Individual Social Interactions: A Discrete Choice Perspective
papers.focus: Uses a discrete-choice perspective to investigate how social interactions and reference groups shape tourism preferences and the formation of market segments.

approach.title: Rigor Through Testing
approach.text: Rigor comes from testing assumptions, comparisons, and uncertainty—not from model complexity alone.

evidence.detail: Questionnaire and experimental design led into multinomial Logit modeling, parameter comparisons, and scenario diagnostics.
Current research training combines building-climate simulation with sensitivity analysis and transparent model evaluation.

approach.title: Compare Before Complexity
approach.text: Start with interpretable comparisons, then ask whether added complexity produces a meaningful gain.

evidence.detail: Model behavior was compared across scenarios before quantitative results were interpreted as market-segmentation evidence.
Choice modeling was considered alongside model failure, sample bias, user outreach, and operational data feedback.

approach.title: Trace the Data
approach.text: Definitions, missingness, anomalies, and source changes are part of the analysis—not cleanup details.

evidence.detail: Multi-regional input-output, customs, balance-of-payments, and services data required definition reconciliation and anomaly review.

evidence.source: National Bureau of Statistics of China
evidence.detail: International indicators were checked against source documentation and aligned definitions before entering the monitoring workflow.

approach.title: Make the Work Inspectable
approach.text: An analysis should leave a clear path that another person can inspect, rerun, and challenge.

evidence.detail: Operational lead data moved through repeatable extraction, cleaning, filtering, and feedback steps.

evidence.source: National Bureau of Statistics of China
evidence.detail: A structured monitoring process connected verified indicator definitions with concise analytical reporting.

zh.metaTitle: 孙奥龙｜统计建模与数据研究
zh.metaDescription: 孙奥龙现为弗吉尼亚理工大学统计学博士生，研究与实践涵盖统计建模、复杂数据分析和机器学习评估。
zh.name: 孙奥龙
zh.eyebrow: 统计建模 · 数据分析 · 机器学习
zh.headline: 以严谨模型分析复杂数据，形成可解释、可检验、可复现的结论。
zh.shortBio: 我现于弗吉尼亚理工大学攻读统计学博士，本科与硕士阶段就读于北京师范大学。研究与实践涵盖统计推断、实验设计、多源数据治理及应用建模。现阶段，我侧重将科学评估方法用于机器学习实践，同时关注模型比较的合理性、结论的可靠性与分析过程的可复现性。

details: 统计推断、线性模型、回归分析与方差分析
实验设计、分类数据分析、概率论与分布理论
建筑与气候仿真、预测建模及敏感性分析
AI 与机器学习模型的科学评估方法

education.degree: 统计学本科 · 经济统计学硕士
details: 经济统计、计量经济学与多元统计分析
投入产出核算、数字贸易和居民消费碳足迹研究
离散选择模型与实证研究设计
机器学习基础和时间序列分析

experience.role: 在研课题 · 建筑、气候与预测建模
experience.summary: 围绕建筑与气候仿真开展预测建模、敏感性分析及 AI 模型评估。
experience.problem: 考察建筑参数和气候条件如何影响仿真结果与预测表现，同时严格区分阶段性发现和已经得到验证的结论。
experience.data: 研究过程中产生的建筑与气候变量、仿真输出及模型评估结果。
experience.method: 结合仿真分析、预测建模、敏感性分析和结构化模型评估。
experience.outcome: 该工作仍处于研究阶段，当前重点是建立支持可复现比较、不确定性分析与透明评估的研究流程。

experience.role: 项目成员 · 数字贸易、投入产出与数据治理
experience.summary: 整合多区域投入产出表、海关、国际收支和服务贸易数据，为 Leontief 投入产出分析准备数据。
experience.problem: 数字贸易测度依赖多类来源，但不同数据在定义、时间范围和部门映射上并不一致。
experience.data: 中国多区域投入产出表、海关数据、国际收支数据及十二类服务贸易数据。
experience.method: 协调指标口径、检查异常，使用机器学习方法辅助修正和插补，再开展 Leontief 投入产出分析。
experience.outcome: 整理出可用于部门关联分析的模型输入，并完整保留数据来源、处理假设和已知局限。

experience.organization: 国家统计局国际数据和信息中心
experience.summary: 围绕世界银行、IMF 和 OECD 的数据建立监测流程，重点核对来源与指标口径。
experience.problem: 跨国指标只有做到定义一致、来源可追溯，才能用于可靠的经济监测和判断。
experience.data: 来自世界银行、IMF 与 OECD 的精选经济指标及其说明资料。

metrics.label: 份参与撰写的分析报告

experience.method: 核验数据来源、协调指标口径，并以固定框架开展监测和简明分析。
experience.outcome: 形成口径一致、来源清晰的国际统计指标监测与分析流程。

experience.role: 研究助理 · 离散选择模型
experience.summary: 设计旅游意愿问卷，并使用 R 分析社会互动、参照群体和市场细分。
experience.problem: 个人的旅游选择会受到社会关系影响，参照群体可能进一步改变市场细分的形成方式。
experience.data: 1,300 余份问卷样本，以及粤港澳大湾区 11 座城市的经济和旅游指标。
experience.method: 开展问卷和实验设计，使用 R 建立多项 Logit 与离散选择模型，并完成平稳性检验、参数比较和情景诊断。
experience.outcome: 通过比较不同情景下的模型表现，解释社会互动如何影响旅游偏好和市场细分。

experience.role: 数据分析实习生 · 司机平台
experience.summary: 使用 SQL 和 Python 整理业务线索，分析司机的车辆选择意向，并参与后续触达和数据回流。
experience.problem: 司机招募既需要稳定的线索数据，也需要理解司机在购车与租车、燃油车与电动车之间的选择。
experience.data: 日常业务线索，以及通过 SQL 提取、清洗和筛选得到的 30,000 余条有效记录。
experience.method: 使用 SQL 建立数据流程，以 Python 整理特征，并用线性判别模型分析司机的选择意向。
experience.outcome: 分析结果用于支持线索运营，同时检视模型失效、样本偏差、用户触达与反馈回流对实际应用的影响。

papers.title: Structural Characteristics of the Household Carbon Footprint in an Aging Society
papers.authors: Ying Long · Jiahao Feng · Aolong Sun · Rui Wang · Yafei Wang
papers.focus: 结合不同年龄群体的消费特征、环境扩展投入产出生命周期评价与结构路径分析，考察老龄化背景下的家庭碳足迹及其关键排放路径。

papers.title: A Novel Integrated Approach for Spatial Analysis of the Coupling Relationship and Its Driving Mechanisms of the Water–Energy–Food–Ecology–Land Nexus in the Yellow River Basin of China
papers.authors: Xianzhi Liu · Ruining Yang · Xinyue Zhang · Aolong Sun · Fei Zhang · Chunyan Li · Junming Li
papers.focus: 分析黄河流域水—能源—粮食—生态—土地系统的时空协调关系、主要制约因素及其驱动机制。

papers.title: Tourism Market Segment Formation through Individual Social Interactions: A Discrete Choice Perspective
papers.focus: 从离散选择视角考察社会互动与参照群体如何影响旅游偏好及市场细分的形成。

approach.title: 统计假设与模型检验
approach.text: 以系统检验保证分析严谨性，重点考察模型假设、比较基准与不确定性，而非单纯追求复杂度。

evidence.detail: 基于问卷与实验设计建立多项 Logit 模型，并通过参数比较和情景诊断检验模型表现。

evidence.signal: 仿真 · 敏感性分析 · 评估
evidence.detail: 在建筑与气候研究中结合仿真、敏感性分析和模型评估，并明确区分阶段性探索与已验证结论。

approach.title: 比较基准与复杂度控制
approach.text: 先建立可解释的比较基准，再评估复杂方法能否带来具有实际意义的增益。

evidence.signal: 情景比较 · 参数诊断
evidence.detail: 比较不同情景下的参数与模型表现，再据此解释市场细分结果。
除判别结果外，同时考察模型失效、样本偏差、用户触达和数据回流所反映的实际限制。

approach.title: 数据溯源与口径核验
approach.text: 将数据来源、统计口径、缺失与异常等质量问题纳入建模决策。

evidence.signal: 4 类来源 · 12 类服务贸易数据
evidence.detail: 整合投入产出表、海关、国际收支与服务贸易数据，并逐项统一统计定义、核查异常。

evidence.source: 国家统计局国际数据和信息中心
evidence.detail: 国际指标纳入监测流程前，先核验来源文件、指标定义与统计口径。

approach.title: 可复核的分析流程
approach.text: 保留清晰、可追溯的分析路径，使结果能够被复核、复现与质询。

evidence.signal: 日常 SQL 流程 · 30,000+ 条记录
evidence.detail: 通过稳定的数据提取、清洗、筛选与回流步骤，形成可重复执行的日常业务流程。

evidence.source: 国家统计局国际数据和信息中心
evidence.detail: 以固定监测框架衔接经核验的指标口径与结构化分析报告。
